# Health services

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Each health service's beds, where referrals were accepted and its open ED movements.

## What is on the screen

1. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly.
2. Each service. Beds in use, pulled, closed and ready. Open a service for its own figures.
3. Where referrals were accepted. Every referral on record, counted by the service that accepted it.
4. Open ED movements. People still in an ED or in transit, counted by service.

## On a phone

- Each service. Beds in use, wards over 85% and open ED movements. Open a service for its own figures.
- Where referrals were accepted. Every referral on record, counted by the service that accepted it.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
